page.notes: The italic opening line is running text, not a heading. The word "Quare," is underlined in the scan, which is not marked here. The first margin note carries the mark "1" and reads "14.Reg.12." in the scan; the leading 1 may be the mark, so the note is read as 4.Reg.12. The page number may be the Roman-style numeral I rather than 1. The superscript marks in the text (1, m, n) are shown in braces as printed. The marginal notes are short and are copied as "Lucan." and "Seneca." with their marks o and p. The first line of this part is a fragment of the sentence continuing from the upper part of the page. The word "vnufquifq;" in the first line is uncertain, and so is the spelling "patefecissent", which the scan shows as a long-s-like form. The reference marks o and p are small and were read from the scan.
